attacked.target: The receipt is classified as income from other sources, ... valued using the telegraphic transfer buying rate on the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027).
attacked.attack: The provision cited, Rule 206, specifies the valuation method for foreign currency income. However, the conclusion mentions valuing the receipt using the telegraphic transfer buying rate on the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027). This is incorrect because Rule 206(2)(b)(i) clearly states that the 'specified date' for 'Income from other sources' is the last day of the tax year of the assessee, which would be 31 March 2027 for the tax year 2026-27. Therefore, the valuation date should be based on the specific type of income and the correct specified date according to the rule.
attacked.evidence: Rule 206(2)(b)(i): The specified date in respect of the nature of income referred in column B of the following Table shall be as given in column C. For 'Income from other sources,' the specified date is the last day of the tax year of the assessee.
